senses.gloss: To a given extent or degree.
very

A person who teaches, especially one employed in a school; preceptor.
One who instructs; a teacher.
A person distinguished for their educational work, a teacher.
A dish made from cattle's or sheep's head and/or trotters and eaten with garlic and/or vinegar.
ability for rational thought
Rational thinking (or the capacity for it); the cognitive faculties, collectively, of conception, judgment, deduction and intuition.

The substance of a brain, as a material or foodstuff.

A quotation mark.
The thin, horny plate at the ends of fingers and toes on humans and some other animals.

An explosive mixture of saltpetre (potassium nitrate), charcoal and sulfur; formerly used in gunnery but now mostly used in fireworks.

A widely diffused vegetable substance, found in seeds, bulbs and tubers, as extracted (e.g. from potatoes, corn, rice, etc.) in the form of a white, glistening, granular or powdery substance, without taste or smell, and giving a very peculiar creaking sound when rubbed between the fingers. It is used as a food, in the production of commercial grape sugar, for stiffening linen in laundries, in making paste, etc.
Of or pertaining to starch.
A strong verbal or written attack on someone or something.
The currency of Bulgaria from 1880 to 2025; divided into 100 stotinki.

(chiefly, US) A person, usually a young, attractive female, who encourages applause and cheers at a sports event, and wearing a specially-designed uniform in the official colors of the team he/she cheers for.
Of or relating to administering or administration.
The state of being alienated.
A pronounced opinion or judgment on a given question.
(religion) god; deity
Given an undue amount of credit for quality or merit in a field; not necessarily related to popularity.
to set in a cast
The office or jurisdiction of an admiral.

A sound made to imitate a ghost.
An island of Tunisia.
Of a location, frequented by a ghost or ghosts.
